scope: Linux browser automation. No physical iPad, Chromebook or Apple Safari was tested.

checks: unsafe live candidate refused intact; literal HTML and inline registered image render in the actual homepage without writes; Cancel restores note, form and focus
left/right/inline placement uses actual note layout; Restore is temporary and Save touches only local HQ draft
actual homepage preview retains safe link destination while blocking click and auxiliary navigation
real homepage scene uses shared typing/arrow/right-portrait UI; focused Enter advances and Escape exits without writing visitor completion
explicit Restore published version restores the saved local draft with undo available
keyboard return and live preview controls fit iPad-like portrait/landscape, Chromebook and 390/320px widths with reduced-motion support
refresh abandons the unsaved live override while keeping published content, preferences, bookmarks and visitor scene state
